title: Design: Change Bill To opens the card's Bill To list
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new open work order for this test for customer B with customer A picked as its Bill To, so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Put customer A on Credit Hold (Edit Customer, Credit Terms: Credit Hold).
  • Start on the work order page.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p3-17-after-change-bill-to.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps: 1. Click Change Bill To in the banner.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The page scrolls to the customer card.
  • The Bill To field is focused with its list open.
  • The "[customer B's name] (this customer)" row is first.

Words in square brackets stand for the value they name, such as customer A's name exactly as it is saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card), story SV-12309 (Story 7, Invoicing to the Bill To)

  • S7-R7: “"Change Bill To" opens and focuses the Customer card's Bill To field; on a phone it first opens the work order details.”
  • S3-R3: “Typing searches every customer in the organization except Counter Sale, A to Z, showing the first 50 matches; the first option is always "[customer] (this customer)".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "3 When the Bill To is blocked", pictures "Change Bill To" (This build).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p3-17-after-change-bill-to.png

The design's own words:

  • “"Change Bill To" opens and focuses the card's Bill To field, so the page scrolls to it.”

Difference: the design draws the current Bill To second, ahead of the A to Z list (BT-D01, question 1, held case DV-01).
